settings.note: Same synthetic inputs and calibrated equal camera pose. Baseline has decorative buildings; candidate uses new cavity. Real tiles, mapped-road workloads, production build and device FPS are not measured.
settings.latency: Trusted pointer events to first subsequent browser RAF callback; idle/orbit hover by 2px each second, inspection-pan drags by 40px each second. This is browser event-to-frame scheduling, not display presentation latency.
